The nearest remembered bank needs just six ordinary route cells, so increasing travel or waiting bounds would not solve this. All water is currently unseen, and no known identification or reconnaissance resource remains. Complete source and reconstruction resolve the packet's selecting-state uncertainty. No patch is supplied because crossing the grass requires an unvalidated change to the transit safety contract; stale bank observations cannot authorize drinking. The unchanged source passes 1910 tests, with four skipped. No new regression or candidate success is claimed.
